messages.author: 9baea6cb50af228a
messages.subject: Issues with Shiny Modules and reactivity
parts:
I'm moving a Shiny dashboard from one file (the old `app.R` setup) to a setup using modules to make it easier to maintain and expand. However, I'm getting endless errors. 

There is a page where the user provides ICD-9 diagnosis codes (or CCS codes, a related concept) and I filter a dataset based on that and return several statistics and analyses on that dataset. Right now I have a function (now part of a module) to handle the extraction that is reproduced below as "filter_records". I then use the resulting data object to make a bunch of tables, plots and counts. In the past using the single app, I've been able to use the resulting data inside another function so long as it was reactive (render* or reactive()). 

I'm trying to do that with the function below called `summary_box_value`. Basically, it just is supposed to take and return the number of rows in the object created by `filter_records`. My server code is reproduced below.  

When I try to run this I get the following error:

Warning: Error in .getReactiveEnvironment()$currentContext: Operation not allowed without an active reactive context. (You tried to do something that can only be done from inside a reactive expression or observer.)

But I can't figure out why because I can't see where I'm doing anything outside of a reactive expression. Any ideas?

server <- function(input, output) {
  visits_with_codes <- callModule(filter_records, "records")
  visitlinks_with_codes <- callModule(filter_records_vl, "visitlinks")
  
  # summary boxes
  callModule(summary_box("n_in_codes",
                         box_icon = "group", 
                         label = "# with codes", 
                         data_object = visitlinks_with_codes, 
                         filter = NULL, 
                         d = NULL))
  callModule(summary_box("vl_percent_with_codes",
                         box_icon = "group", 
                         label = "% with codes", 
                         data_object = visitlinks_with_codes, 
                         filter = NULL, 
                         d = total_vl)) # d means divide by d to make % instead of #
}


filter_records <- function(input, output, session) {
  reactive({
    withProgress(message = 'Please wait: Extracting cases', {
      # logic to handle if searching by diagnosis code or procedure code
      if (input$define_by_pr == 0) {
        if (input$ccs == 0) {
          icd_codes = parse_icd(input$icd9)
          records <- filter(sid, DXCODE %n% icd_codes)
        } else {
          ccs_codes <- inner_join(ccs_labels, 
                                  data.frame(ccs_label = input$ccs_words))
          records <- filter(sid, DXCCS %in% ccs_codes$ccs_code)
        }
      } else {
        icd_codes <- parse_pr(input$icd9_pr)
        records <- filter(sid, prcode %in% icd_codes)
      }
    })
    records
  })
}

summary_box_value <- function(input, output, session, box_icon, label, 
                              data_object, filter_str = NULL, d = NULL) {
  renderInfoBox({
    sub_nrow <- nrow(data_object())
    if (is.null(d) == FALSE) {
      sub_nrow <- round(sub_nrow / d, 2)
    }
    sub_nrow = format(sub_nrow, big.mark = ",")
    renderInfoBox(
      infoBox(label, value, icon = icon(box_icon)))
  })
}
